phases.description: Bring wack/rust-service-template up to parity with its mature siblings (aviary, keystore, metricstore, hare). Tickets are sourced verbatim from template-modernization-tickets.md (companion: template-maturity-audit.html). Priority tiers P0 (correctness/reproducibility), P1 (fleet parity), and P2 (modernization/hygiene) are tracked per-ticket; hare is the CI/CLAUDE.md reference but is HTTP-layout exempt.
phases.label: PHASE 1
phases.name: Template Modernization
phases.summary: 22 file-grained tickets bringing the template to fleet parity (P0/P1/P2).
